design_philosophy: Premium quant research cockpit. E1 Design Principles: Control Room grid, visual hierarchy first (charts > tables), high contrast typography, deep neon accents on dark canvas. ADHD-friendly layout.

rules.headings: Big page titles, tight tracking (tracking-tight). No generic sans like Inter.
rules.labels: Small uppercase with wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]) for section labels.
rules.metrics: Tabular numeric variant MUST be used for all metric numbers (font-mono).
rules.size_minimum: No tiny typography. Base size text-sm minimum on desktop.

layout_and_spacing.grid_protocol: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID. Dense, data correlation, 1px solid borders, optical alignment.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard, favor tight gaps (gap-4/gap-6) inside widgets and wider gaps (gap-8/gap-12) between main sections.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid #223142. Selected states use 1px solid #22D3EE + subtle cyan inner shadow/glow.

cards.default: bg-[#121C29] border border-[#223142] rounded-lg shadow-sm p-4 md:p-6

verdict_pills.strong: bg-[#22C55E]/10 text-[#22C55E] border border-[#22C55E]/30 px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider
verdict_pills.selective: bg-[#F59E0B]/10 text-[#F59E0B] border border-[#F59E0B]/30 px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider
verdict_pills.avoid: bg-[#EF4444]/10 text-[#EF4444] border border-[#EF4444]/30 px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider

toggle_chips.active: bg-[#22D3EE]/10 text-[#22D3EE] border border-[#22D3EE]/50 rounded-md px-3 py-1 text-sm font-medium
toggle_chips.inactive: bg-transparent text-[#64748B] border border-[#223142] hover:border-[#94A3B8] rounded-md px-3 py-1 text-sm font-medium

charts.styling: Transparent backgrounds. Grid lines stroke-[#223142] stroke-dasharray='3 3'. Custom HTML tooltips with bg-[#121C29] border border-[#223142] and text-[#E5EDF7].
charts.colors: Use theme colors (Positive, Negative, Info, Structure) directly in Recharts stroke/fill attributes.

sections.description: Header / Controls — Title + subtitle + direction toggle + Preview Mode toggle + actions.
3-column comparison (Baseline, Preview, Delta). Huge tabular numbers. Green/Red text based on positive/negative deltas.
Grid of 6 bento cards (Asia, London, etc.). Include verdict pills, sparklines, metric rows, and toggle chips.
4-panel horizontal bento: Bar chart (Net R), Donut (Direction), Donut (Structure), H-Bar (Top Entry).
Complex bottom section with a left-side Tabs navigator (Overview, Direction Lab, etc.) and a Sticky right panel (Quick Controls & Impact).

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create the single page mounted at /session-lab using React and Tailwind.
Implement all visual toggles as stateful UI elements (no backend logic needed, use mock data).
Utilize Phosphor icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react) for dense, professional data UI.
Avoid Shadcn 'Card' wrappers if they restrict the Control Room layout; use pure div HTML with the specified colors.
Ensure Recharts components are styled heavily to match the dark theme (no white tooltip backgrounds!).
Add sticky positioning to the Quick Controls panel on the right side of the Deep Dive section.
Use font-mono for all numeric metrics and uppercase tracking-[0.2em] for small labels to create a technical 'HUD' feel.
